subject: Executive summary & PayWave reference for expansion
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Ross <emily.ross@paywave.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Reference for PayWave expansion

Hi Emily,

Hope you had a good weekend — quick ask as we prepare materials for your upcoming renewal/expansion. We're putting together a short executive summary + one-page outcomes brief that highlights the wins PayWave has seen on Redwood. Would you be willing to: 

- Allow Redwood to publish a 1-page case summary using PayWave branding (logo + link back to PayWave site)?
- Confirm a 1–2 sentence quote from either you or Daniel we can use in the deck?
- Confirm the headline metrics below are OK to publish (we'll anonymize $ amounts):
    * Average inference latency reduced ~25% (p95)
    * Inference unit cost decreased ~40% after batching/quantization changes
    * Production uptime 99.95% for Q2–Q3 2026

If yes, I can send a draft exec summary and a little form for legal sign-off. We aim to have the collateral ready by next Friday for the expansion pitch.

Thanks — appreciate it.

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
[Attachment: example_case_template.pdf (pdf)]
From: Emily Ross <emily.ross@paywave.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@paywave.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Reference for PayWave expansion

Ben — thanks for the note. We're happy to be a reference and to have you highlight the outcomes; that data lines up with our internal analysis. A couple of constraints from legal:

- PayWave Legal will need a short consent form to sign (we can review and sign within 3 business days).
- We prefer that any dollar amounts be redacted or presented as percentages (ok to keep latency/cost %s).
- If you want a named quote from me or Daniel, we'll draft something once we see the final one-pager.

Can you send the draft exec summary + the consent form and loop in your legal contact? CCing Daniel so he's aware.

Best,
Emily Ross
Head of Product, PayWave
emily.ross@paywave.com | +1 (650) 555-2299
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Ross <emily.ross@paywave.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Executive summary draft + consent form (PayWave)

Emily — attaching the draft one-pager and a short consent template for PayWave Legal. Quick notes:

- The one-pager (attached) contains a cover quote section we left blank — please feel free to suggest exact wording.
- We've redacted dollar amounts and used percent improvements per your note.
- If PayWave is OK with the quote text below, we can slot it into the final layout and share the final PDF for signature.

Draft quote placeholder: "Redwood's runtime reductions and batching work accelerated our inference pipeline, enabling faster feature launches and lowering per-inference cost significantly."

Attachments (3): paywave_exec_summary_v1.pdf (draft one-pager), paywave_signed_reference_consent.pdf (consent template), paywave_outcomes_table.csv (supporting numbers)

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/98765

Appreciate a quick turnaround if possible — we're targeting the expansion deck next Thursday.

Thanks!
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Emily Ross <emily.ross@paywave.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@paywave.com>, PayWave Legal <legal@paywave.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 10:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive summary draft + consent form (PayWave)

On Fri, Oct 1, 2026 at 08:27 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Emily — attaching the draft one-pager and a short consent template for PayWave Legal. Quick notes:
> 
> - The one-pager (attached) contains a cover quote section we left blank — please feel free to suggest exact wording.
> - We've redacted dollar amounts and used percent improvements per your note.
> - If PayWave is OK with the quote text below, we can slot it into the final layout and share the final PDF for signature.

Thanks — we reviewed the draft. We're comfortable with the structure and the percent metrics. Below are the exact metrics we authorize you to publish (please use percentages, no raw revenue figures):

- Latency: p95 inference latency reduced 24–27% after batching changes (round to 25% headline)
- Cost: inference unit cost reduction ~38% (you may say ~40% as a rounded headline)
- Uptime: 99.95% production availability (Q2–Q3 2026)

Quote (signed off):
"Redwood reduced our inference costs and improved latency in a way that materially sped up our product roadmap — the team was able to ship critical features faster with predictable performance guarantees."

We give Redwood permission to:
- Use PayWave's logo on the one-pager and associated marketing collateral
- Use the approved metrics and the quote above

PayWave Legal will execute the short consent form; I've attached a signed copy for your records. One ask: please keep the detailed CSV (paywave_outcomes_table.csv) internal to Redwood — it contains breakdowns we prefer not to publish.

Attaching: paywave_signed_reference_consent.pdf (signed), note: paywave_outcomes_table.csv — internal only

—Emily
Emily Ross
Head of Product, PayWave
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Final assets: PayWave one-pager + signed consent

Ben / Marissa — good news, Emily returned the signed consent and approved the quote and percent metrics. I've finalized the one-pager and produced:

- paywave_exec_summary_final.pdf (final, includes approved quote + logo)
- paywave_signed_reference_consent.pdf (signed by PayWave Legal)

Per Emily's request we will NOT publish paywave_outcomes_table.csv; it's stored in the private folder. I've uploaded the final assets to the Drive link below and updated HubSpot with the signed consent (Deal ID 98765).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPayWaveCaseStudy
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/98765 (consent attached)

Next steps: Ben, if you're happy with the final PDF I can coordinate with Growth to add the one-pager to the expansion packet and schedule a short case study post for next week.

Thanks — great cross-team turnaround.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189
